in_sanskrit.name: Bibak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Wise, Intelligent
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bibak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bibak means 'wise' or 'intelligent'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bibhak', which means 'one who understands'. Bibak is a powerful name that symbolizes wisdom and intelligence. It is a name that is often given to children who are believed to have a bright future and a sharp mind.
